notes.title: Armor Clash 2022 Version 2.0
notes.content:
New Fetures:
1. 4 Mission Maps
Before start each mission maps, players can choose one special unit for the mission, which will give them defferent strategies.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41764900/0e4ff6d6fc13606a89240beea8f0390212a28cd7.png[/img]


2.  3 Technology Treess are completed.
There is a  level 3 super upgrade for each technology trees, which will enfence the Airforces, Land Armors, Marines.

Air Force:
Advanced airforce. Allow the airfield to make next generarion jet instead of current ones.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41764900/35d6d9c1fe758054e6187434da4f681f5ea36c17.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41764900/9c2f901dc68430b41a70ccb13e8fad7c5f123404.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41764900/a10cd809f511bd81d6fa32ec336899cdb8fd36ae.png[/img]

Land Armor:
Advanced command vehicle. Allow command vehicle to let tanks nearby to fire high explosive shells.

Marine:
Advanced Navy. Allow all frigates and destroyers equip X-47 attack drones.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41764900/37a6bc2c6c48c32a9f667923c175ab7571b30511.png[/img]


3. Infantries deploying.
All infantries can deploying into firebase model; which will let them have great fire range and power.
All infantries can also add a flying pack to become air units.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41764900/1c6c50aed08a92eb5eed277db87b98e8eb3487f9.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41764900/4dbc89ce29d80626290ede7aeca7e5bb93f92127.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41764900/424a205568c71ff99d897ae6d57fd641b2e74e22.png[/img]

New Units:
F-22 instead of F-14 when players upgrade the "Advanced Airforce".
Su-47 instead of Su-25 when players upgrade the "Advanced Airforce".
F-35 instead of Rafales when players upgrade the "Advanced Airforce".

DDG-1000
A fast speed T-3 warship
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41764900/3b0a3a95e26885c451ee29ccea69eb60327d0859.png[/img]

LCS
A fast speed T-2 warship
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41764900/97a37545d491690b25371ee9ff96b9f85f4fe1af.png[/img]

Motar Ship
A T-1 ship with a long fire range.


Future updates:
I will also keep updating the game by adding new units and maps. The next period of time I will focous on increasing the graphic and streamlining the performance.

If you like this game, please give a comment on the storepage, which will let more players know it:)

notes.title: Armor Clash 2022 finished early access and come to version 1.0
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41764900/704c8d60d2f18a866412764ff934afa138665882.png[/img]
After 3 month's early access, Armor Clash 2022 is now entering version 1.00;
During the 3 months, I added features like commander abilities, technology system and the navies.
[h2]Main features:[/h2]
1. AI Skirmish with base buildings. (1V1, 2V2, 3V3)
2. Navy units included. Simultaneous combat on land, sea and air.
3. 3 Technology tree (Mastery: Airforce, Land Armor, Navy) and 2 super units for each technology, like B-2 bomber, Aircraft Carrier and Battleship.
4. Commander abilities on the map, like calling A-10 strikers or EMP waves.
5. Players can customize their factions by 70+ units and 8 camoflages in the Armory.

[h3]1V1 Map:[/h3]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41764900/9c7e28ef6f06e85320a96e228f8e783c07fe264f.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41764900/b5669a401dfacd7c2df9f98811e1a618458c7651.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41764900/a4a08de5858adf2300198526319483e361402dce.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41764900/31461756758b087fa3c38f5dcd3507cdae5d7570.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41764900/90c93dbb7d99cd2f818b1b6544bc3ba17b037ad8.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41764900/dbade184c04d3a2bf4738e01d2bdafcde4b53e3b.png[/img][/url]

[h3]2V2 Map:[/h3]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41764900/b7a048cba03162372107fd334d2914e48578bb6c.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41764900/ed83fd65f69fcffe95cc570a42b86a76cee647ab.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41764900/292ed2b7d9905770e83a4e1de292f778080ca4ee.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41764900/46a3c859a64de2772c06b584ee87a960d4dbc56a.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41764900/71bb402dac7877007d140873b1af07971398b46b.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41764900/975da6d98a8107fb87af4c415b4d461a03d236ab.png[/img][/url]

[h3]3V3 Map:[/h3]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41764900/bd8dbbd2303df725dd1803779ca3d5141b4a8a58.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41764900/eb9f470fc9eb0835762635c9fc1211395acc454a.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Future Upgrade Plan[/h2]
In the future, it will be still upgraded for free, 
[h3]1. Challenge Maps[/h3]
Various challenge modes are waiting for players to participate, such as survival mode where players will use limited resources to resist waves of crazy enemy forces, or escort designated units to their destination in escort mode.
[h3]2. Campaign Maps[/h3]
After completing the challenge mode, I will continue to work on a series of campaign missions, which will include more flexible game modes and in-game cutscenes.
